author: MattGaetz
text:
For more context, the White House holds regular press briefings to ensure accurate information is provided — but even then the media lies and peddles misinformation.

That article was included to highlight the White House going to great lengths to provide important access, only to have it distorted and manipulated by the propagandists in the media.
